text: Since I don't have experience with the Laravel framework, I started to watch some tutorials and read some documentation to set up the Laravel environment
I started designing the basic layout, including the header, navigation menu, and introductory section for the website
I also organize the structure of the page using HTML, CSS, and Laravel Blade templates
I continued improving the landing page by adding more sections such as About Us, Mission, Vision, and Objectives.
Minor adjustments were also made to improve the layout and alignment of elements.
I also tested the navigation links and page structure.
I realized that simplicity of UI is a must for responsiveness in different sizes of gadgets.
I improved the design of the employer dashboard and worked on making it responsive for different screen sizes
After improving the design, I tested the dashboard features and navigation to ensure they function properly.
This activity helped me develop better skills in UI design and responsiveness.
I continued working on the PESO admin dashboard and its features for managing the job portal system
I created the initial layout and sections of the admin dashboard that will allow the administrator to monitor job postings, manage users, and oversee system activities
This task helped me understand the importance of an admin panel and how feedback from supervisors helps improve the overall design and functionality of the system
I started developing the jobseeker dashboard and its basic features for the job portal system
I worked on designing the layout and making some parts of the dashboard responsive to ensure it works well on different screen sizes
I polished the functions in the jobseeker dashboard to ensure that all features were working properly
I also checked the connections with the admin and employer dashboards to ensure smooth data flow
This task helped me understand the importance of refining system features for better performance and user experience.
I focused on polishing my previous work on the employer dashboard.
I also tested the dashboard to ensure that all elements were working correctly and efficiently
I polished my previous work on the admin dashboard to improve its overall functionality and design
This experience helped me understand the importance of continuous improvement in developing a reliable and efficient system.
I created the login and registration pages for the job portal system
I designed the layout and structure to make it simple and user-friendly for new users and returning users.
I also started setting up the basic functionality for user authentication.
This task helped me understand the importance of secure and accessible login systems in web applications.
I ensured that the input fields, validation, and user interface were properly working and easy to understand
This activity helped me improve my skills in handling form validation and routing in the system.
I checked the authentication process to ensure that users can log in smoothly and securely.
I also tested the error handling and responsiveness of the page on different devices.
This task helped me understand the importance of a reliable login system for user access and security.
I entered and organized the survey results using Google Forms for data collection and documentation.
I polished the design of the admin dashboard and improved its functions as part of my individual task.
I fixed some errors in the employer dashboard, particularly in the job management section.

On the twenty-first day, I fixed some errors in the employer dashboard, particularly in the job management section. I reviewed the existing functions, identified issues, and applied the necessary corrections to ensure smooth performance. I also tested the updated features to confirm that job postings can be managed properly. This task helped me improve my debugging and problem-solving skills in system development.

On the twenty-third day, I volunteered as one of the SPES examination proctors. I assisted in monitoring the examinees, maintaining order in the room, and ensuring that the examination process was conducted properly. I also helped in distributing and collecting examination materials. This task helped me develop responsibility, patience, and confidence in handling official activities.
On the twenty-fourth day, we checked the examination papers for the SPES examination. This task helped me realize the importance of being careful, accurate in handling examination records.

On the twenty-fifth day, I attended the IT Fest at NBSC to showcase our Capstone study to the first-year up to third-year IT students. We presented the features, purpose, and development process of our project to inspire and share knowledge with other students. I also answered questions regarding our study and system. This experience helped me improve my communication skills and confidence.

On the twenty-sixth day, I started working on the employer dashboard as part of the collaborative task. I added the Post New Job page and developed its functions to allow employers to create and submit job postings. I also checked the layout and responsiveness of the page to ensure usability. This task helped me improve my skills in feature development and teamwork.

On the twenty-seventh day, I continued working on the employer dashboard as part of the collaborative task. I added the Manage Job page, Company Profile section, and their corresponding functions to improve employer account management. I also reviewed the interface to make sure it was organized and user-friendly. This task helped me understand the importance of building complete and functional dashboard features.

On the twenty-eighth day, I changed the routing of the job post section and updated the header of the Manage Jobs page to improve navigation and organization. I also added the download function for the company profile to allow employers to download their information easily. This task helped me improve my understanding of routing and file handling functions in the system.

On the twenty-ninth day, I added the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service pages to the login and registration sections of the Job Portal System. I ensured that users can access these pages properly before creating or logging into their accounts. This task helped me understand the importance of legal policies and user agreements in web applications.

On the thirtieth day, I enhanced the user interface of the Request LRA/SRA and Submit Documents sections to improve usability and responsiveness. I also added the View Applicants function and improved its design for better organization and user experience. This task helped me improve my skills in UI enhancement and feature integration.

On the thirty-first day, I fixed the issue where users get stuck during the registration process. I also added Save Jobs, Skill Gap, and PESO Clearance functions in the jobseeker dashboard to improve user accessibility and functionality. This task helped me improve my debugging and feature development skills.

On the thirty-second day, I updated the Browse Jobs function and added the Applied Jobs function in the jobseeker dashboard. I ensured that users can easily browse available jobs and monitor the jobs they applied for within the system. This task helped me understand the importance of organizing job application features for better user experience.

On the thirty-third day, I updated the job list displayed on the landing page to show only approved job posts. I also improved the Request PESO Clearance feature in the jobseeker dashboard to ensure smoother production and navigation. This task helped me improve my skills in filtering data and enhancing user dashboard functions.

On the thirty-fourth day, I continued updating the landing page job list for approved job posts and enhanced the Request PESO Clearance feature in the jobseeker dashboard. I reviewed the functionality and responsiveness of the pages to ensure proper performance. This task helped me understand the importance of continuous system testing and improvement.

On the thirty-fifth day, I updated and fixed the View Applicants and Show Applicants functions in the employer dashboard. I also improved the alignment and spacing of the downloaded resume PDF to ensure a cleaner and more professional format. This task helped me enhance my skills in debugging and document formatting.

On the thirty-eighth day, I fixed the error encountered when navigating the Recommended Job section of the system. I reviewed the routing and functionality to ensure that users can access recommended jobs smoothly without issues. This task helped me improve my troubleshooting and navigation debugging skills.

On the forty-fourth day, I continued assisting in encoding profiling information into the PEIS System. I reviewed and entered records while ensuring that the information was accurate and complete. This task helped me improve my data entry and organizational skills.

On the forty-fifth day, I continued updating and encoding records in the PEIS System. I carefully checked the information before submission to avoid errors and inconsistencies. This experience enhanced my attention to detail and accuracy.

On the forty-sixth day, I continued assisting with the profiling data entry process in the PEIS System. I organized and encoded records while maintaining data accuracy and consistency. This task helped me understand the value of proper information management in government services.

On the forty-eighth day, we presented our Job Portal System for evaluation and checking. We received feedback and suggestions regarding additional features, improvements, and possible missing functions that could enhance the system. This experience helped me understand the importance of system evaluation, user feedback, and continuous improvement in software development.

On the fiftieth day, I updated the user interface of the LRA/SRA request section to make it more organized, user-friendly, and responsive. I reviewed the layout and adjusted design elements to improve the overall user experience. This activity helped me strengthen my skills in UI design and usability improvement.

On the fifty-first day, I developed the auto-generation feature for LRA/SRA certificates. This function automatically generates certificates based on the submitted information of users, reducing manual processing time. This task helped me understand the importance of automation in improving system efficiency and productivity.

On the fifty-second day, I updated and fixed the structure of the generated LRA/SRA certificates. I improved the formatting, alignment, and overall layout to ensure that the certificates appear professional and properly organized. This task helped me enhance my attention to detail and document generation skills.

On the fifty-third day, I added the View function for LRA/SRA certificates to allow users and administrators to view generated certificates directly within the system. I ensured that the feature displays certificate information properly and is easy to access. This task helped me improve my skills in feature development and system usability enhancement.

On the fifty-fourth day, I added the History function for LRA/SRA certificates. This feature allows users to view previously generated certificates and maintain a record of their requests. This task helped me understand the importance of record management and data tracking within a system.

On the fifty-fifth day, I updated and improved the Post New Job feature in the employer dashboard. I reviewed the existing functionality, improved the user interface, and ensured that job posting processes work correctly and efficiently. This activity helped me strengthen my skills in feature enhancement and user experience improvement.

On the fifty-sixth day, I assisted in the encoding of profiling information into the PEIS System. I carefully entered and reviewed records to ensure that the data was accurate and complete. This task helped me improve my attention to detail and data management skills.

On the fifty-seventh day, I continued assisting in the encoding of profiling information into the PEIS System. I verified the submitted information and organized records for proper documentation. This activity helped me understand the importance of accuracy and consistency when handling data.
